description: Replace every link on a profile or link page; for a few changes use edit_links. Pass ids from list_links to keep click history; omitted links are deleted with their click counts. Order is section order; at most 2 pinned, 50 in all. Same-group links show under the group name; null removes it. trackingEnabled:false links are not counted.

id.description: Existing link id; keeps its click history.

name: set_links
title: Set links
